name: Eighth Heaven
source:
Esrafil's trumpet hath rung. In three months, a world will end. A world subject to the throes of nature and chance. A world where for a moment you see the sun draw curtains through leaves, and for a moment you laugh together at a dumb joke, and for a moment you see her blush, and never again, never in the same way.

But there is another way. Indeed, man has snatched eternity from God's grimy hands. This is the next stage of human evolution; an existence unburdened by fleeting moments.

ཐི𝔦ཋྀ Faced with the choice of this afterlife, Nita and Galia grapple with love and change. One girl attracted to the immovable gravity of the future and another stuck in the tempting inertia of the past.

ཐི𝔦ཋྀ Many decades later, in the fungal mass that remains of the world, a lonely girl searches for a companion. Wronged by the world and writhing in her unconsented involvement with life itself, she believes that what is needed to mend her is someone who shares her condition.

[From [url=https://threetare.itch.io/eighth-heaven]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃斯拉菲尔的号角已经吹响。三个月后，世界将终结。一个受到自然和机遇的阵痛影响的世界。在这个世界里，有那么一刻，你看到太阳透过树叶拉上窗帘，有那么一刻，你们一起因为一个愚蠢的笑话而大笑，有那么一刻，你看到她脸红了，但再也不会了，再也不会以同样的方式了。

但还有另一种方法。确实，人类已经从上帝肮脏的手中夺走了永恒。这是人类进化的下一阶段；一种不受转瞬即逝的时刻所束缚的存在。

ཐི𝔦ཋྀ 面对来世的选择，妮塔和加利亚努力应对爱和改变。一个女孩被未来不可动摇的引力所吸引，另一个女孩则陷入了过去诱人的惰性。

ཐི𝔦ཋྀ 几十年后，在世界上残留的真菌群中，一个孤独的女孩寻找同伴。她受到世界的委屈，并在未经同意的情况下卷入生活本身而痛苦不堪，她相信需要有人与她有同样的处境来治愈她。

[来自[url=https://threetare.itch.io/eighth-heaven]itch.io[/url]]
